title: Mobile/touch: stage drawing & interaction does not work on touch devices
description:
## Repro (mobile/touch device)
Open the editor on a touch device (tablet/phone). Pick any drawing tool (pencil/brush/rect/oval/line/pen) and try to draw on the stage with a finger. Nothing draws. Selecting/dragging objects by touch also fails. Touch gestures instead scroll/zoom the page.

## Root cause (file:line)
The stage interaction surface is bound EXCLUSIVELY to mouse events and has no touch-action.
- packages/authoring-ui/src/StageArea.tsx:4390-4393 — the work-area <div> wires onMouseDown/onMouseMove/onMouseUp/onMouseLeave only. There are NO onPointer* or onTouch* handlers (confirmed: grep for onPointer|onTouch across StageArea.tsx returns nothing). On a touch device the browser never synthesizes the mouse sequence needed for a drag gesture, so onMouseDown->onMouseMove->onMouseUp drawing/drag never fires.
- packages/authoring-ui/src/StageArea.tsx:4233 (workAreaStyle) — no touchAction. Without 'touch-action: none' on the interaction surface, the browser claims touch gestures for native pan/zoom/scroll instead of delivering them to the canvas, so even pointer handlers would be pre-empted mid-stroke.

The handler bodies (onMouseDown at 4390, onMouseMove at 4391, onMouseUp at 4392) already take generic event objects and use clientX/clientY via toStageCoords; they do not depend on mouse-only fields, so they are pointer-portable.

## Expected vs actual
- Expected: dragging a finger on the stage draws/selects/moves exactly as a mouse drag does.
- Actual: touch produces no drawing or selection; the page scrolls/zooms instead.

## Fix direction
- Switch the stage work-area handlers to Pointer Events (onPointerDown/Move/Up + onPointerLeave), which unify mouse+pen+touch, OR add parallel onTouchStart/Move/End handlers that adapt touch.touches[0] into the same code path.
- Add 'touchAction: "none"' to workAreaStyle (StageArea.tsx:4233) so the surface owns touch gestures. Consider setPointerCapture on pointerdown for robust off-element drags.
- The right-pane resize handle (Shell useResize) is also mouse-only — see the separate responsive-pane task; converting useResize to pointer events resolves touch-resize there.

## Classification
Mobile/touch is an UNSUPPORTED-PLATFORM GAP, not a regression. The editor is a desktop Tauri app; there is no touch/pointer/responsive code anywhere in packages/authoring-ui/src (grep for onPointer|onTouch|matchMedia|@media returns nothing) and no docs claim mobile support. Priority medium: mobile is a secondary target.

## References
- packages/authoring-ui/src/StageArea.tsx:4233 (workAreaStyle), 4384-4403 (work-area div + handler bindings), 4390-4393 (onMouse* bindings)
- Sibling tasks: tap-selection (user-select) and responsive right-pane.
